capabilities: Open a local graph of the current note in a side panel
Navigate the graph with arrow keys, holding Ctrl to reverse link direction
Limit visible nodes with the G-span setting
Filter graph nodes by checking or unchecking tags
Add or remove tags on the selected note from the graph panel
extras: Not yet in the community plugin store; the demo is unpublished. The graph model initializes at application startup, which the author notes can cause longer loading times.
intentEvidence: A slightly different Graph navigation and visualization for Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian's built-in local graph lacks keyboard navigation and tag-based filtering or coloring for exploring how a note connects to its neighbors.

relations.evidence: Easiest option of installation is through BRAT plugin

summary: Local graph panel with keyboard navigation, adjustable span, and tag-based filtering and coloring, shown beside the current note.
